title: See how a measurement is spread

version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]

## Most replies come within ten minutes

These illustrative reply times show where support answers cluster and how far the slow ones trail. RichView estimates the curve from the sample; the note under the chart names the method and its bandwidth.

```chart
type: density
title: Replies cluster near seven minutes, with a long slow tail
subtitle: Minutes to first reply
data:
  inline:
    - {minutes: 3.1}
    - {minutes: 4.2}
    - {minutes: 4.8}
    - {minutes: 5.0}
    - {minutes: 5.3}
    - {minutes: 5.9}
    - {minutes: 6.1}
    - {minutes: 6.4}
    - {minutes: 6.6}
    - {minutes: 7.0}
    - {minutes: 7.2}
    - {minutes: 7.5}
    - {minutes: 7.9}
    - {minutes: 8.3}
    - {minutes: 8.8}
    - {minutes: 9.4}
    - {minutes: 10.1}
    - {minutes: 10.9}
    - {minutes: 12.0}
    - {minutes: 13.8}
    - {minutes: 15.5}
    - {minutes: 18.9}
encoding: {x: minutes}
axes:
  x: {label: Minutes to first reply}
```

*Source: Illustrative values. The curve is computed, not measured.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read the density along the curve.
